name: telemedicine-ai-app
description: AI-powered telemedicine platform connecting patients with healthcare providers

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../middleware && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:middleware" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../middleware && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:middleware" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../middleware && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../middleware && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test

author: Telemedicine AI Team
